title.en: 3D Scientific Congress with Interactive Posters and Presentation Videos
title.es: Congreso Científico 3D con Pósters Interactivos y Videos de Presentaciones

description.en:
A virtual scientific congress with a 3D poster hall: each poster is a panel showing an abstract and a presentation video (5-15 min). On proximity, video preview activates; on click, the full presentation plays in an overlay with the paper PDF (PDF.js). Filters by topic area and a favorites system with CSV export. Guided tour mode through relevant posters. Q&A sessions where attendees leave questions anchored to video timestamps.

Performance: long videos segmented by chapters, thumbnails and proxies for scrubbing. Accessibility: subtitles, transcripts, aria on controls, prefers-reduced-motion. Metrics: papers viewed, videos played, questions sent. Recommendations for paper metadata and video formats included.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, congress3d.js, assets/ (GLB poster hall models, presentation videos, PDFs).

**Stack:** Three.js, video HTML5, PDF.js, GSAP.

**Interactions:** Click poster opens video + abstract + PDF, filters by topic, favorites with CSV export, guided tour mode, Q&A anchored to video timestamps.

title.en: 3D Tech Expo with Video Demos and Interactive Stations
title.es: Expo Tecnológica 3D con Demos en Video y Estaciones Interactivas

description.en:
A tech expo where each station shows a technical demo and an explanatory video detailing architecture, APIs and use cases. The scene is a pavilion with thematic islands (AI, security, infra) and a 3D map for navigation. Selecting a station triggers a GSAP fly-to and the demo video plays on a 3D screen; alongside the video a panel shows highlighted code snippets (Prism.js) and a Try in Sandbox button (external link).

Demos include live 3D visualizations (data flows) synced with video via JSON cues. Deep dive mode pauses playback and allows inspecting logs and metrics in floating panels. Performance: heavy demos load on demand, Web Workers compatible. Accessibility: subtitles, transcripts, aria on snippets, prefers-reduced-motion. Metrics: demos started, snippets copied, time in deep dive. Sandbox integration and snippet security recommendations included.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, expo3d.js, assets/ (GLB station models, demo videos, JSON snippets).

**Stack:** Three.js, video HTML5, Prism.js, GSAP.

**Interactions:** Click station opens video + code snippet + sandbox button, 3D map navigation, deep dive mode with logs/metrics, live data visualization synced with video.

During the gala, the camera alternates between presenter and testimonial screens with cinematic transitions; key moments (announcements, winning bids) generate highlight clips saved to a gallery. Donor mode shows benefits and allows receipt download. Performance: adaptive streaming, LOD for decorations. Accessibility: subtitles, transcripts, aria on forms, prefers-reduced-motion. Privacy: explain data use for donations. Metrics: simulated donations, bids, testimonial plays. Legal recommendations for auctions and data handling included.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, gala3d.js, assets/ (testimonial videos, GLB stage models, audio tracks).

**Stack:** Three.js, HLS.js, WebRTC, GSAP.

title.en: 3D Music Festival with Main Stage, Side Screens and Replay Clips
title.es: Festival Musical 3D con Escenario Principal, Pantallas Laterales y Replay Clips

description.en:
A 3D music festival experience: main stage with giant screens, low-poly virtual audience, and side screens playing highlight clips (interviews, backstage). The live artist stream projects as a texture on the center screen; main audio routes through WebAudio for stem control (vocals, bass, percussion) in the UI. During the show, users can mark moments generating 10-30s clips stored in a local queue and shareable via UI.

Camera angles: front row, side, bird's eye; changing angle applies smooth dolly and adjusts lighting. Real-time reactions (emojis) subtly affect stage lighting and particles. Director mode: replay the concert with free camera and key moment markers. Clip gallery with thumbnails and subtitles.

Performance: limit animated avatars, LOD for crowd, adaptive streaming, pause offscreen. Accessibility: live subtitles, transcripts, prefers-reduced-motion. Privacy: explain camera/mic before enabling live interaction. Metrics: clips created, reactions, view time per angle.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, festival3d.js, assets/ (HLS/WebRTC streams, highlight clips, GLB stage models, audio stems).

**Stack:** Three.js, HLS.js/WebRTC, WebAudio API, GSAP, postprocessing (bloom).

**Interactions:** 3 camera angles (front/side/bird), WebAudio stem control, emoji reactions with particle effects, mark clips with M key, director mode replay with markers, clip gallery, metrics per angle.

description.en:

On proximity, video preview activates; on click, an overlay opens with extended video, ingredients and delivery order links. Filters by cuisine type reorder stands with 3D animation and a floating map shows stand locations.

Includes a guided tasting route: camera moves between selected stands with smooth transitions and voiceover introducing each proposal. Social area where visitors can leave video reviews (locally recorded via WebRTC) displayed on a 3D mural. Recipe videos include subtitles and a downloadable steps list.

Performance: proxies for scrubbing, 512-1024px textures, lazy-load videos, release resources after inactivity. Accessibility: subtitles, aria on buttons, prefers-reduced-motion. Analytics: simulated reservations, video plays, filters used. Video compression and menu format recommendations included.

**Stack:** Three.js, video HTML5, GSAP, LazySizes.

**Interactions:** Click stand opens recipe video + menu + reserve, filters by cuisine reorder stands, floating map, guided tasting route with voiceover, social video reviews, downloadable recipe steps.

description.en:
Website for "Estudio Tropic", contemporary tropical architecture office (Luis Barragán + Lina Bo Bardi style). Warm, colorful but sophisticated aesthetic.

* Palette: pink sand background #f0d9c4, dark wine text #3d1a1a, mustard yellow accent #d9a441, jungle green #2e4a32.
* Fonts: DM Serif Display for large headlines + DM Sans for body.

Philosophy block on jungle green background with yellow typography. Project cards with solid color frames (each project a different color from the palette). Contact form on postcard type.
* Details: Generous flat color blocks, colored shadows (not black), arches and curved shapes as decorative elements, photographs with warm tint.

description.en:

Key play markers generate highlight clips and a timeline with scrubbing; proxies are used for fluidity. Real-time stats overlays (possession, shots) sync with the replay. Social commenting anchored to timestamps. Performance: adaptive streaming, LOD for crowd, pause render on inactive tabs. Accessibility: subtitles, transcripts, prefers-reduced-motion. Metrics: replays viewed, angles selected, comments per timestamp.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, sports3d.js, assets/ (replay clips, highlight chunks, stadium GLB model).

**Stack:** Three.js, GSAP, HLS.js (adaptive streaming), WebSocket for live data.

**Features:**
- Free orbit camera with height/distance constraints.
- Replay selection cards trigger video load and camera fly-in.
- Timeline with scrubbing and key-play markers.
- Real-time stat panel (possession, shots) synced to replay.
- Comments anchored to timestamps.
- Adaptive streaming via HLS.js.
- LOD for crowd dots, pause when tab hidden.
- IndexedDB for usage metrics.
- prefers-reduced-motion support.
- Subtitles & transcripts for accessibility.

title.en: Elegant 3D Library with Educational Video Clips and Semantic Search

description.en:
Build an elegant 3D library where shelves hold volumes that open to play educational video clips, combined with semantic search to find content by topic, duration, or level.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, library.js, assets/ folder with clips, metadata, thumbnails.

**Stack:** Three.js, HTML5 video, Algolia or local semantic search, GSAP.

**Description:** 3D library where each shelf contains volumes that, when opened, play educational video clips. The experience combines elegant spatial navigation with semantic search that lets users find clips by topic, duration, or level.

**Semantic search:** User types a query; the engine returns results ranked by semantic similarity (embedding) and relevant shelves illuminate in the scene. Results show thumbnails and a snippet; selecting one triggers a fly-to toward the volume and the clip plays.

**Clips & metadata:** Each clip has JSON metadata: title, duration, language, transcript, tags. Side panel shows transcript with synchronized highlights (scroll-to-time). SRT subtitles and downloadable transcript option.

**Spatial interactions:** Free walk through aisles with orbit/first-person toggle. Quick keyboard focus (keys 1–9) for popular sections. Favorites: drag clip to 3D "cart" to create a playlist.

**Playback & quality:** Adaptive streaming when available; preload thumbnails and metadata. Pause playback when user moves away; option to play in background in HTML panel.

**Accessibility & fallback:** ARIA on controls, subtitles, transcripts, and 2D version with list and player. prefers-reduced-motion reduces transitions and disables fly-to.

**Performance:** Progressive shelf loading; LOD for models; 512–1024px textures. Pause render when canvas off-viewport; requestIdleCallback for non-critical tasks.

**Analytics:** Search terms, clips played, average time per clip, most common navigation paths. Camera heatmaps to identify areas of interest.

UI allows selecting cameras (stage, audience, backstage) and creating synced clips shared in the event gallery. Live polls and Q&A displayed both in the physical room and the 3D replica. Performance: adaptive streaming, low-latency sync, pause render offscreen. Accessibility: live subtitles, transcripts, prefers-reduced-motion. Metrics: remote attendees, clips created, successful syncs. Technical recommendations for clock sync and tolerable latency.

**Deliverables:** index.html, styles.css, hybrid3d.js, assets/ (HLS streams, clips, GLB venue models).

**Stack:** Three.js, HLS.js, WebSocket, GSAP.

**Interactions:** Camera selector (stage/audience/backstage), create synced clips with M key, live polls, timestamped Q&A, clip gallery, sync status indicator, 2D fallback.

Rendimiento: streaming adaptativo, baja latencia, pausar render fuera de viewport. Accesibilidad: subtítulos en vivo, transcripciones, prefers-reduced-motion. Métricas: asistentes remotos, clips creados, sincronizaciones exitosas. Recomendaciones técnicas para sincronización de relojes y latencia tolerable.

**Entregables:** index.html, styles.css, hybrid3d.js, assets/ (streams HLS, clips, modelos GLB venue).

**Stack:** Three.js, HLS.js, WebSocket, GSAP.

**Interacciones:** Selector de cámaras (stage/audience/backstage), crear clips sincronizados con tecla M, encuestas en vivo, Q&A con timestamp, galería de clips, indicador de sincronización, fallback 2D.
